method: Existing memory_measure Release binary, three fresh process runs; synthetic temporary data. These are requested Rust allocation bytes, not RSS or footprint. No SDK A/B comparison.

runs.scope: Requested Rust heap bytes only; excludes SQLite/C allocations, allocator overhead, VM, OS, Bridge, Flutter and GPU. Not RSS or physical footprint.
